root.name: タワーセミコンダクター

relations.text: 2023年9月、Intelがニューメキシコ州の300mm工場でTowerの顧客向けウェハーを製造するための生産枠をTowerの指示で確保する契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: In September 2023, Tower and Intel signed an agreement under which Intel committed to build a capacity corridor at Tower's instructions to manufacture wafers for Tower's customers in its 300mm facility in New Mexico

source.label: Tower Semiconductor 20-F
source.quote: In September 2023, Tower and Intel signed an agreement under which Intel has committed to build a capacity corridor at Tower’s instructions, in order for Intel to manufacture wafers for Tower’s customers in Intel’s 300mm facility in New Mexico, USA.

relations.text: TowerはこのIntel工場に設置する設備等への投資を約束している
relations.text_en: Tower committed to invest in equipment and other fixed assets to be installed in this Intel facility

source.label: Tower Semiconductor 20-F
source.quote: Under this agreement, Tower has committed to invest up to $ 300,000 for equipment and other fixed assets to be owned by Tower and to be installed and qualified for Tower processes and for its customer products in this Intel facility.
